metadata.title: Cowboy on Horseback with Text Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, high-contrast image featuring a cowboy on a galloping white horse, kicking up red dust against a backdrop of blue mountains and sky. The composition is dominated by the horse and rider, with bold white text overlaid at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The cowboy and horse are in motion, creating a strong diagonal line from lower left to upper right.
The bright red dust contrasts sharply with the blue sky and the white horse, drawing attention to the action.
The white text at the top provides a stark visual counterpoint to the vibrant, textured background.
The cowboy's gaze is directed forward, aligning with the horse's movement and the implied direction of the text.
coreInvariants: A cowboy in traditional western attire (hat, chaps, lasso) riding a horse.
The horse is white or very light-colored and appears to be galloping or in fast motion.
A significant amount of red/orange dust or debris is kicked up by the horse's hooves.
A clear blue sky and distant mountains form the background.
Bold, sans-serif white text is positioned prominently at the top of the image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The cowboy and horse occupy the central and lower-right two-thirds of the image, scaled to be the dominant visual elements. The horse's head is near the right edge, and its body extends towards the lower-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white horse and the cowboy are the primary visual anchors, with the red dust cloud serving as a secondary anchor due to its high contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the white text at the top, down to the cowboy's head, then follows the horse's body diagonally across the image to the red dust cloud, implying forward motion and energy.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky and distant mountains in the upper left and center act as negative space, providing a clean backdrop for the text and contrasting with the detailed foreground action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Blue, from the sky and mountains, provides a cool, expansive backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red, from the dust cloud, creates high contrast and emphasizes the action and energy.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White, used for the horse and the text, provides bright highlights and draws attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The image features high saturation in the blues and reds, with the white elements providing high value contrast. The overall impression is vibrant and energetic.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a strong blue for the sky/background.
Ensure a vivid red/orange for the dust.
Use white or very light grey for the horse.
Limit the color palette to these dominant hues for maximum impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif, monolinear strokes, wide proportions, open counters, high x-height.
letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke width throughout each character.
Minimal contrast between thick and thin strokes.

composition.position: top left, spanning across the upper third of the image
composition.overlap: partially overlaps distant mountains, but remains fully legible
composition.relationshipToImage: overlaid on the sky/mountain background, creating a strong visual statement

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: No pairing, as only one typographic element is present.

preserve: Placement in the upper third of the image

candidateDirections.reason: Strong geometric sans-serif characteristics, good weight, and wide proportions.
Modern geometric sans-serif with clear, open forms and good legibility at large sizes.
Clean, wide, and robust geometric sans-serif that conveys strength and clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of a cowboy on a white horse galloping through a dusty, arid landscape. The horse should be kicking up significant red-orange dust. In the background, include clear blue skies and distant, hazy mountains. Ensure the cowboy is looking forward and the horse is in dynamic motion. The overall image should have a high-contrast, slightly vintage or grainy photographic quality.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the text 'REALITY AWAITS' in all-caps, bold, white geometric sans-serif font. Position it in the upper left to upper center of the image, ensuring it is clearly legible against the sky and mountains, without obscuring critical details of the cowboy or horse.

verificationChecks: Is the text 'REALITY AWAITS' present and in all-caps?
Is the text white and a bold geometric sans-serif?
Is the text positioned in the upper third of the image?
Is the cowboy on a white or light-colored horse?
Is red-orange dust clearly visible around the horse's hooves?
Are blue mountains and sky visible in the background?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for the sky
Intensity and spread of the red dust
Graininess or vintage filter applied to the image
Exact position of the text within the upper third

mustAchieve: Dynamic sense of motion from the horse and rider.
Strong color contrast between the blue background and red dust.
Clear legibility of the white text against the background.
Overall impression of a classic, adventurous western scene.
avoid: Static or posed appearance of the horse and rider.
Muted or desaturated colors that diminish impact.
Text that is difficult to read due to color, font choice, or placement.
Modern or anachronistic elements that detract from the western theme.

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text is 'REALITY AWAITS' and is white, bold, and all-caps.
Verify the horse is light-colored and in motion, kicking up red dust.
Check for a clear blue sky and mountains in the background.
Ensure the overall image has a high-contrast, possibly slightly grainy, aesthetic.
Confirm no logos, watermarks, or unintended text are present.
Assess the balance and impact of the text in relation to the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a high-energy western scene with a cowboy on a white horse kicking up red dust against a blue mountain backdrop. Overlay bold, white, all-caps geometric sans-serif text 'REALITY AWAITS' at the top.
